plan.name: Check both comparison outcomes and keep healthy final charts
plan.summary: Complete #723 in one plumbing change by sharing verification's captured-comparison validation and wording with the dashboard, recomputing the full expected comparison or printable diagnostic from the receipt commit even when the receipt omits it, and checking presence, complete contents and candidate rules/bounds identity symmetrically, with an absent file distinguished from an empty or damaged file and no new input-hash schema. Validate the original final reader independently, retaining all model/include/view/lock, report and reader fingerprint, pin, bounds, tool, count, chart-consistency and companion checks before displaying its complete chart and poster beside a comparison_evidence diagnostic; comparison-only failure removes only the comparison presentation, final too_large and unavailable outcomes remain specific, and neither an arbitrary archived SVG nor unrelated final-evidence damage qualifies for fallback. Render fallback through the shared native renderer without mutating or resealing retained reports, distinguish proposal sources from independently synthesized final sources, check final-chart companion content separately from comparison-only presentation differences, and bind diagnostics, captured sources and rendered content into immutable URLs and ETags while preserving unchanged no-comparison identities and D-0353's whole-snapshot refusal, archive retry and recovery after cache corruption. Make the diagnostic visible as literal text beside the affected project's chart on public and /act rows and table entries, including grouped implementations, and preserve verification verdicts, assurance, verification fingerprints, proposal hashes and locks. Update SPEC.md, docs/statecharts.md and docs/dashboard.md to describe symmetric binding and comparison-only fallback with recorded D-0351, D-0353, D-0362 and D-0364 grounds on changed SPEC bullets; run the affected Go suites, archive/restart regressions and normal required checks, leaving decision recording of this refinement and unavailable local Docker/network checks to the merger without replacing applicable real Python or TLAPS CI.

tests.name: TestReceipt723ComparisonPresenceIsSymmetric
tests.says: The receipt and its commit must agree on comparison absence, the complete valid comparison or the complete diagnostic; omitted, unexpected and substituted evidence is diagnosed while healthy final evidence survives, and legacy absence and separately synthesized final sources remain valid.

tests.name: TestReceipt723DamagedComparisonKeepsFinalTopology
tests.says: Malformed, empty, stale, wrong-lock and undrawable comparison inputs, and mismatched receipt diagnostics, retain the complete independently valid final topology, report and posters beside a literal comparison_evidence diagnostic on the card, page and native SVG, including after restart.

tests.name: TestReceipt723FallbackStillChecksFinalEvidence
tests.says: Comparison fallback never excuses corrupt final sources, fingerprints, pins, bounds, counts, tools, chart topology, reader.json or native SVG companions, including a forged final drawing with intact embedded metadata.

tests.name: TestReceipt723FinalLimitationsStaySpecific
tests.says: An omitted or mismatched comparison beside a final too_large or unavailable outcome adds its own diagnostic without claiming a final chart, inventing an empty graph or losing the specific final outcome across restart.

tests.name: TestReceipt723FallbackIdentityAndCacheRecovery
tests.says: Fallback changes presentation URLs and conditional responses, unchanged evidence survives restart, and corruption of a cached fallback still rejects the whole saved snapshot and old images until authoritative archive recovery.
